newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile calls germanium/white metals meetings.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile calls germanium/white metals meetings.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center is to hold a meeting in New York to hear industry comment on how best to sell the government's hoard of surplus germanium, platinum and palladium.
The Center has already sent draft invitations to bid for all three metals to interested parties for written comment by February 7.
A meeting will then be held in New York on February 19 to discuss the issues raised.
David Brown of the DLA said that a week or two after February's meeting, proper invitations to bid for each metal will be issued.
In the fiscal year begining October 1, 1996 the Stockpile has authority to sell 4,000 kilos of germanium metal, 15,000 troy ounces of palladium, and 10,188.05 troy ounces of platinum, Brown said.
Stockpile inventory of germanium totals 68,198 kilos, with a further 1.264 million ounces of palladium and 450,000 ounces of platinum.
On February 19 the germanium meeting will be held at 0930 to 1130 EST, followed by palladium and platinum at 1330 to 1530.
